summary: Recent commentary marks the anniversary of a National Guard deployment to Washington, D.C., with advocates arguing that the incident underscores the case for statehood. A senator has committed to prioritizing D.C. statehood, while civil rights and voting rights organizations continue to highlight concerns about federal control over the District's governance. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.

articles.title: Why we shouldn’t have National Guard Troops in D.C.
